The Fourier series for an even function on \( (-L, L) \) contains:
For \( f(x) \) defined on \( (-L, L) \), at the endpoints \( x = \pm L \), the Fourier series converges to:

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(f(x) = \frac{a_0}{2} + \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} [a_n \cos(\frac{n\pi x}{L}) + b_n \sin(\frac{n\pi x}{L})]\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{where: } a_0 = \frac{1}{L} \int_{-L}^{L} f(x) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(a_n = \frac{1}{L} \int_{-L}^{L} f(x) \cos(\frac{n\pi x}{L}) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(b_n = \frac{1}{L} \int_{-L}^{L} f(x) \sin(\frac{n\pi x}{L}) dx\)

(2 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Write Fourier series for function in } (-L, L).\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{For even } f(x): b_n = 0\)

(2 Mark)

\(a_0 = \frac{2}{L} \int_0^{L} f(x) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(a_n = \frac{2}{L} \int_0^{L} f(x) \cos(\frac{n\pi x}{L}) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Series becomes cosine series}\)

(2 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{For even function in } (-L, L), \text{ simplify coefficient formulas.}\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{For odd } f(x): a_0 = 0, a_n = 0\)

(2 Mark)

\(b_n = \frac{2}{L} \int_0^{L} f(x) \sin(\frac{n\pi x}{L}) dx\)

(3 Mark)

\(\text{Series becomes sine series: } f(x) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} b_n \sin(\frac{n\pi x}{L})\)

(3 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{For odd function in } (-L, L), \text{ simplify coefficient formulas.}\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{Odd function since } f(-x) = -x = -f(x)\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Thus } a_0 = 0, a_n = 0\)

(2 Mark)

\(b_n = \frac{2}{L} \int_0^{L} x \sin(\frac{n\pi x}{L}) dx = \frac{2L}{n\pi}(-1)^{n+1}\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Thus } x = \frac{2L}{\pi}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n} \sin(\frac{n\pi x}{L})\)

(2 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find Fourier series for } f(x) = x \text{ in } (-L, L). \text{ Is it even or odd?}\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{Replace } \pi \text{ by } L \text{ and } x \text{ by } \frac{\pi x}{L} \text{ in } (-\pi,\pi) \text{ formulas}\)

(3 Mark)

\(\text{Basic forms identical: } f(x) = \frac{a_0}{2} + \sum (a_n \cos\omega_n x + b_n \sin\omega_n x)\)

(3 Mark)

\(\text{For } (-\pi,\pi): \omega_n = n; \text{ for } (-L,L): \omega_n = \frac{n\pi}{L}\)

(2 Mark)
